name: yoanbernabeu
description: Opinionated Symfony skills, installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: symfony-yoandev-skills
plugins.description: Sixteen opinionated skills for writing Symfony applications, in two tiers: five core rules (test first, a Controller/Service/Repository contract, DTOs at both edges, rules in services) that cost nothing per feature, and on-demand practices (deptrac, query-count tests, Messenger, caches, health checks) switched on by a real need. AssetMapper with no bundler. Verified against a real Symfony 8.1 install and a running deptrac rather than against documentation.
